question: Which of the following is an award presented for classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalidas Samman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalidas Samman is a prestigious award presented by the government of Madhya Pradesh to recognize contributions in the field of classical arts, literature, and culture.
 
• The 'Kalidas Samman' is given by the** Madhya Pradesh government.**
 
• It is a prestigious award presented annually by the government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The award is named after Kalidasa, a writer of ancient history.
 
• '**Kalidas Samman was established in the year 1980-81.**
 
• In this award, Rs. 2,00,000 and a citation are presented in the fields of classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual art.
 
• First recipients: Semmangudi Srinivasa Iyer and Mallikarjun Mansur
 
• Dharwad: Renowned Hindustani classical vocalist Pt M Venkateshkumar of Dharwad was recently conferred the prestigious Kalidas Samman for his outstanding contribution to the field of classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kabir Puraskar** is an award presented for promoting communal harmony and national integration through literature.

 
 
• It is presented by the government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Saraswati Samman** is an award presented for outstanding contributions to Indian literature.
 
 
• It is presented by the K.K. Birla Foundation.
 
 
 
• ** Jnanpith Award is the highest literary **award in India, presented for outstanding contribution in the field of literature.
